source: OpenCV Zoo face_detection_yunet, face_detection_yunet_2023mar.onnx, input made dynamic by dev/models/make_yunet_dynamic.py

input.name: input
input.constraint: H and W must be multiples of 32; we feed a square crop of 1.4x the head box, resized to 160x160

output.names: cls_s, obj_s, bbox_s, kps_s for the strides s = 8, 16, 32
output.decode: score = sqrt(cls * obj); cx = (bbox0 + col) * s, cy = (bbox1 + row) * s, w = exp(bbox2) * s, h = exp(bbox3) * s; landmark j: x = (kps[2j] + col) * s, y = (kps[2j+1] + row) * s
